properties.name: grails.views.markup.allowResourceExpansion
properties.description: Whether to allow resource expansion in Markup Views.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.autoEscape
properties.description: Whether to escape XML special characters in Markup Views.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.autoIndent
properties.description: Whether to indent generated markup automatically.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.autoIndentString
properties.description: The string used for each automatic indentation level.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.autoNewLine
properties.description: Whether to insert new lines in generated markup automatically.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.baseTemplateClass
properties.description: The base template class for Markup Views.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.cache
properties.description: Whether to cache compiled Markup View templates. Defaults to false in development and true otherwise.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.cacheTemplates
properties.description: Whether the markup template engine caches compiled templates. Defaults to false in development and true otherwise.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.compileStatic
properties.description: Whether Markup Views are statically compiled.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.declarationEncoding
properties.description: The character encoding declared in generated XML declarations.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.enableReloading
properties.description: Whether Markup Views are reloaded when they change. Defaults to true in development and false otherwise.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.encoding
properties.description: The character encoding for Markup Views.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.expandEmptyElements
properties.description: Whether empty markup elements use expanded opening and closing tags.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.extension
properties.description: The file extension for Markup View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.locale
properties.description: The locale used by the markup template engine.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.mimeTypes
properties.description: MIME types handled by Markup Views.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.newLineString
properties.description: The string used for generated line breaks.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.packageImports
properties.description: Packages imported into Markup View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.packageName
properties.description: The package name used for compiled Markup Views. Defaults to the application name.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.prettyPrint
properties.description: Whether to pretty-print generated markup.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.staticImports
properties.description: Static classes imported into Markup View templates.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.templatePath
properties.description: The filesystem path containing Markup View templates. Defaults to the environment reload location or application views directory.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.useAbsoluteLinks
properties.description: Whether links generated by Markup Views use absolute URLs.

properties.name: grails.views.markup.useDoubleQuotes
properties.description: Whether generated markup uses double quotes for attribute values.
